meta.title: Season reference for Kyoto (used only for the dashboard's visual theme)

seasons_source.name: JMA forecast terms: 時に関する用語 (春 3–5月, 夏 6–8月, 秋 9–11月, 冬 12–2月)

phenology_source.name: 京都地方気象台 植物季節観測 (Kyoto Local Meteorological Office, plant phenology)

assumptions: The cherry-blossom window (7 days before the normal flowering date to 7 days after the normal full-bloom date) and the autumn-leaves window (14 days before the normal ginkgo yellowing date to 7 days after the normal maple reddening date) are this project's choice for the visual theme. They are approximate and say nothing about this year's trees.
Normals are for the observation trees at the Kyoto Local Meteorological Office; other places in the prefecture differ, especially in the mountains and the north.
